title: E/11125/2014 — Shree Meenaskshi Food Products Pvt Ltd vs. Vapi
text:
CUSTOMS, EXCISE AND SERVICE TAX APPELLATE TRIBUNAL
West Zonal Bench, AHMEDABAD
COURT NO. I
Application No. E/EH/11012,11022-11024/2018–DB
(Appeal No. E/11120,11122-11123,11125/2014)
[Arising out of Order-in-Original No. OIO-VAP-EXCUS-000-COM-063-067-13-14
dated 11.12.2013 passed by Commissioner Central Excise, Vapi]
M/s. Shree Meenaskshi Food Products Pvt. Limited : Applicant
vs.
Commissioner of Central Excise & ST, Vapi : Respondent
Appearance:
None for the Applicant (s)
Shri Gobind Jha, Superintendent, (AR) for the Respondent(s)
CORAM:
Hon’ble Mr. Ramesh Nair, Member (Judicial)
Hon’ble Mr. Raju, Member (Technical)
Date of Hearing/ Decision : 31.01.2019
Misc. Order No. M/10061-10064/2019
Per : Ramesh Nair
These early hearing applications are filed by the Revenue on the ground
that the revenue involved is more than Rs. 122 Crores. Considering that huge
revenue is involved, we allow the early hearing applications. List the appeals for
regular hearings on 26.02.2019.
(Order dictated and pronounced in the court)
Raju Ramesh Nair
Member (Technical) Member (Judicial)
KL
petitioner: Shree Meenaskshi Food Products Pvt Ltd
